environment.probeMethod: independent library import + real CLI invocation + boundary simulation; NOT reliant on the 63 fixtures or the green advisory workflow

baselineVerification.note: origin/main and origin/master (the control-plane authorities) equal the fixed lineage SHAs. Local main/master tracking branches sit ahead of origin from unrelated local dev worktrees; this validation neither created nor modified them.

immutableLayerVerification.method: git diff --name-only across the correction range touches none of validation-009/**, correction-010 CONTRACT/STATE/PROMPT, governance/**, research-ops-pilot/**, or research-ops/tasks/**; name-only emptiness across the range proves byte-identity.

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: force-package flag
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: validate --require-package on an empty skeleton fails closed (ok=false, forced check false); confirmed via library and CLI.

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: state/evidence consistency
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: All 8 higher declared states over an empty package fail in validate AND report status inconsistent; one shared derivation (evidence.mjs) used by both.

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: workflow discovery fail-closed
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: Workflow verifies non-empty base/head, git cat-file -e both commits, runs git diff --name-status with no '|| true'; empty changed set refused by check-boundary (exit 1). Advisory run on 2b9fecd succeeded read-only.

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: task-root deletion rejected
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: check-boundary on a D record under a task root exits 1; boundary flags status=D governed deletions; missing referenced root fails the validate step.

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: CI append-only boundary wired
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: check-boundary is invoked by the workflow and enforces one-task-root/forbidden-area/top-level/traversal rules. NOTE: the boundary is shallow — see probes B (rename source), D (workflow allowlist) and E (stage immutability).

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: --tasks-dir confinement
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: CLI exposes no output-path flag; --tasks-dir rejected as unknown; testRoot is library-only. NOTE: confinement is cwd-relative, not worktree-root-bound — probe A shows create writes <cwd>/research-ops/tasks/ outside the repo. See probe A (CORRECTION_REQUIRED).

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: nested package entries
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: Exactly eleven flat regular files enforced; nested directory, hidden file and any extra entry each make validate fail.

correctionMatrixC1ToC9.name: structural/schema enforcement
correctionMatrixC1ToC9.evidence: TASK_STATE (keys, taskId, state, full boolean auth matrix, unknown *Authorized-true rejected), IDENTITY (presence + TASK_STATE consistency + canonical inventory) and GITHUB_PLAN (taskId/model/base/draft/autoMerge/mergeAuthorized) enforced. SCOPE NOTE: does not cover the four non-ID research JSON shapes (probe H) nor GITHUB_PLAN branch cross-binding (probe F) nor identity grammar (probe G).

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: actual repository-root confinement / CWD escape
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: createTask uses process.cwd()+research-ops/tasks. Real CLI from an OS temp dir created <TMPD>/research-ops/tasks/CBW-PROBE-A-TMP-001; from a repo subdirectory created <subdir>/research-ops/tasks/... (NOT the repo-root tasks dir). No worktree-root resolution and no fail-closed outside a supported worktree.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: rename/copy name-status integrity
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: parseNameStatus keeps only parts[last] (the destination). An R100 record 'research-ops-pilot/tasks/OKX-DONE/immutable.json -> research-ops/tasks/CBW-A/00-contract/x.json' passes the boundary (ok=true): deletion/movement of an immutable governed SOURCE is hidden. Unknown/unsupported status codes (e.g. Z999) are accepted rather than rejected; source path never evaluated.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: PR-mode identity
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: classifyChangeMode is derived only from changed paths. A change touching only a factory/workflow file is classified FACTORY_GOVERNANCE and passes regardless of branch/PR/task metadata; mode is not bound to trusted PR/branch/task identity — mode-confusion is possible.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: workflow allowlist precision
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: FACTORY_PREFIXES allowlists the entire '.github/workflows/' prefix. A change to '.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml' passes in FACTORY_GOVERNANCE mode (ok=true). Factory governance grants blanket authority over all workflows, not just the factory validation workflow.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: stage-aware append-only
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: checkChangedFileBoundary enforces only single-task-root + forbidden areas. Modifications (status M) to closed earlier stages (00-contract/**, re-manifested 20-research-output/**, 50-source-truth-review/**) within one root are all accepted (ok=true). No stage-transition immutability; a one-task-root rule is not append-only.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: GITHUB_PLAN cross-binding
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: validateGithubPlanShape does not compare GITHUB_PLAN.taskBranch to TASK_STATE.branch, nor pullRequest.head to taskBranch. A plan with taskBranch/head mismatched to TASK_STATE.branch still passes (shape ok=true).

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: identity grammar/types
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: At validate time IDENTITY fields are checked for presence and equality to TASK_STATE only, not grammar. Malformed-but-consistent countryCode='zz9!' and exchangeId='../evil' pass validation (ok=true). These fields drive deterministic branch/path generation.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: all nine research JSON shapes
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: Manifest-valid packages whose top-level shape was replaced with [] were ACCEPTED for research-run.json, offer-eligibility-review.json, schema-normalization-notes.json and import-readiness.json. Structural validation is limited to the five ID-collection files plus cross-refs; four research JSONs accept arbitrary valid JSON.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: owner receipt structure
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: Only the exact research-record merge receipt for the exact task passes. wrongType/wrongTask/wrongTarget/missingMerge/deploy-escalation/master-escalation/nested-escalation/non-object all yield mergeAuthorized=false; nested and master escalations explicitly rejected.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: invalid UTF-8
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: Canonical encoding check tests only BOM and CR (hasBOM/hasCR). Invalid UTF-8 bytes (0xFF/0xFE/0x80) injected into source-truth-review-report.md and into a JSON string value, with MANIFEST recomputed over raw bytes, pass the canonical-UTF-8 check (ok=true). Replacement-character decoding is not validated against.

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: higher-stage marker integrity
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: stageSatisfied uses exists() only. A zero-byte 70-validation/VALIDATION.json and a malformed-JSON 70-validation/VALIDATION.json each satisfy the VALIDATED state gate (consistency ok=true). Markers are existence-only, not parsed or identity-bound. (Symlink markers are separately caught by findUnsafeEntries.)

newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.name: actual workflow + boundary behavior
newBypassProbeMatrixAtoL.evidence: Advisory workflow run 30206225962 on 2b9fecd succeeded, read-only (contents:read, persist-credentials:false), no merge/deploy/AI. Boundary simulation: multipleRoots=fail, taskOnly=pass, factoryOnly=pass, mixed=fail, deletion=fail, forbidden=fail, topLevel=fail, traversal=fail — as designed for the cases it covers. NOTE: green workflow is NOT sufficient evidence; the invoked boundary carries the B/C/D/E gaps.

workflowValidation.unrelatedNote: Those two failures are pre-existing push-triggered repo workflows unrelated to the factory and untouched by this correction; they do not gate factory validation.
workflowValidation.judgment: The factory workflow is correctly read-only and fail-closed at the discovery layer, but it delegates append-only enforcement to a boundary whose semantics are incomplete (probes B/C/D/E). A green run does not establish a tight append-only guarantee.

authorizationValidation.note: The authorization/security floor is intact and was not breached by any probe; the corrections-required findings are boundary/validation-completeness gaps, not privilege escalations.

correctionRequiredFindings.summary: create is confined to <cwd>/research-ops/tasks/, not the actual worktree root; reproducibly writes outside the repository when invoked from a temp dir or subdirectory.
No stage-aware append-only enforcement; modification of closed earlier stages within one task root is accepted.
Rename/copy name-status parsing evaluates only the destination; deletion/movement of an immutable governed source is hidden, and unknown status codes are accepted.
Factory-governance mode allowlists the entire .github/workflows/ prefix; an unrelated deploy/production workflow change is accepted.
Four research JSON files (research-run, offer-eligibility-review, schema-normalization-notes, import-readiness) accept arbitrary valid-JSON top-level shapes.
Invalid UTF-8 byte sequences are accepted; canonical encoding checks only BOM/CR, not byte-sequence validity.
PR mode is derived only from changed paths, not bound to trusted branch/PR/task metadata; mode-confusion is possible.
Higher-stage state gates are satisfied by existence-only markers; zero-byte and malformed-JSON markers pass without being parsed or identity-bound.
GITHUB_PLAN.taskBranch/pullRequest.head are not cross-bound to TASK_STATE.branch.
Identity field grammar (country/exchange/batch/priority) is not enforced at validate time; only presence and equality to TASK_STATE are checked.

nonblockingNotes: Local main/master branches are ahead of origin from unrelated local dev worktrees; the control-plane origin SHAs match the fixed lineage and were not modified by this task.
Unrelated push-triggered workflows (telegram-reports.yml, critical-alerts.yml) fail on the correction head but are outside the factory scope and untouched by this correction.
Owner receipt validation does not require every canonical false authorization key to be present, but defaults are safe because any non-merge true key is rejected.
Symlink/executable/non-regular entries anywhere in a task are caught by findUnsafeEntries, so a symlink higher-stage marker is rejected even though marker content is otherwise unvalidated.
requiredCorrections: A: Resolve the actual Git worktree root for create output (or fail closed outside a supported worktree); never write <cwd>/research-ops/tasks when cwd is not the repo root.
B: Parse both source and destination of R/C records; reject deletion/movement of immutable governed sources; reject unknown/unsupported status codes and malformed records.
C: Bind FACTORY_GOVERNANCE vs RESEARCH_TASK to trusted branch/PR/task metadata, not changed paths alone.
D: Replace the blanket .github/workflows/ allowlist with an exact allowlist of the factory validation workflow (and explicitly governed factory files).
E: Enforce stage-transition append-only immutability within a task root, not just a single-root restriction.
F: Cross-bind TASK_STATE.branch, GITHUB_PLAN.taskBranch and pullRequest.head; enforce base=main across both plan fields.
G: Enforce safe grammar/types for identity fields used to generate deterministic branches and paths at validate time.
H: Enforce minimum top-level structural shapes for all nine research JSON files, not only the five ID collections.
J: Validate canonical UTF-8 byte-sequence validity (reject invalid bytes), not merely BOM/CR.
K: Require higher-stage markers to be regular, parseable and identity-bound where JSON is expected.
